root_idea.summary: The root centers on aversion: physical dirt or stink gives rise to expressions of disgust, annoyance, contempt, and vexation.
root_idea.development: Alongside this exclamatory and emotional field, the lexicon preserves a distinct branch denoting the time or occasion of something, as well as related derivatives for habitual vexation and hard-heartedness.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form أُفٌّ.

senses.definition: An exclamation of disgust or aversion—“uff!”—expressing annoyance, vexation, distress, dislike, contempt, or disrespect.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as an utterance, including in constructions addressed to someone or something with لِـ. In the Quranic construction, it marks even the slightest verbal expression of revulsion, displeasure, or treating the addressee’s matter as burdensome.

senses.definition: Filth, dirt, or stink regarded with disgust or contempt.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic admonition, the literal association with filth or stink supplies the force of the expression and its prohibition; this does not mean that every occurrence must be translated as a literal material substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter “uff” out of anxiety, vexation, distress, or disgust; to be angry or enraged at someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb whose utterance may be directed toward a person or occasion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dirt or filth, especially dirt of the ear, dirt around or under the nail, or a nail paring; also a small stick or reed picked up from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical item is associated with things judged dirty, filthy, or offensive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A puff or blast of breath used to blow away dust, ashes, or another annoying substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete action underlying the exclamatory use of the word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Paucity; a small amount or scant quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a lexical sense of the nominal form, distinct from its exclamatory use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dirty, filthy, or unclean man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or nominal designation derived from the association with dirt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A poor or needy person, possessing little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from the sense of paucity or small quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vexation, distress of mind, or disgust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or abstract noun for the emotional state expressed by saying أُفٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coward; one who holds back from fighting through disgust, and hence a heavy or sluggish person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The fighting-related construction describes withdrawal or reluctance attributed to disgust; it is not a Quranic sense of أُفٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who says أُفٌّ frequently or continually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A habitual-agent designation formed from repeated utterance of the exclamation.
Used in expressions meaning “at the time of that” or “at that occasion.”
A related classical derivative associated with the root’s aversion-based semantic field.

cautions: Lane records many vocalic and orthographic variants of أُفٌّ; they are consolidated under one normalized public headword.
Lane's printed Quran citation is not used to generate a modern verse location; the examples here use independently supplied QAC locations.
